title: chat-server: enforce ChatLimits body/attachment limits and blob checks
description: maxBodyBytes from ChatLimits, not the hard-coded 100_000 (message.rs:686-697, L689). Enforce maxAttachmentBytes and maxAttachmentsPerMessage (draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md L238-242, L1676). Check attachment size and sha256 against the blob through a backend hook (L281-290); the sha256 comparison MUST be constant-time (compliance-tests §14.13). E2EE empty-field rule on update is JMAP-4dmj (not repeated). Error code for body over limit: see spec bead jmap-chat-spec-y3rm.
acceptance_criteria: Tests use an independent oracle: each assertion cites and quotes the governing draft sentence (file + line) or uses RFC/draft-published vectors; the code under test is never its own oracle. Tests: body at/over configured maxBodyBytes; attachment count/size limits; mismatched size or sha256 rejected (RFC 6234 / known SHA-256 vector for the fixture blob); constant-time compare used (subtle/ct_eq or equivalent).
